Key relations: reversible isothermal work $|w| = nRT\ln\dfrac{V_2}{V_1}$; irreversible work against constant external pressure $|w| = p_{ext}\Delta V$; for an ideal gas $\Delta U = nC_V\Delta T$ and $\Delta H = nC_p\Delta T$.
A: $|w| = 2\times 8.314\ \text{J K}^{-1}\text{mol}^{-1}\times 300\ \text{K}\times 2.303\log\dfrac{20}{2} = 4988.4\times 2.303\ \text{J} \approx 11488\ \text{J} \approx 11.5\ \text{kJ}$, so A matches II.
B: $|w| = 3\times10^{3}\ \text{Pa}\times(3-1)\ \text{m}^3 = 6000\ \text{J} = 6\ \text{kJ}$, so B matches III.
C: $|\Delta U| = 1\times\tfrac{3}{2}\times 8.314\ \text{J K}^{-1}\times 320\ \text{K} = 3990.7\ \text{J} \approx 4\ \text{kJ}$, so C matches I.
D: $\Delta H = 1\times\tfrac{5}{2}\times 8.314\ \text{J K}^{-1}\times 337\ \text{K} = 7004.5\ \text{J} \approx 7\ \text{kJ}$, so D matches IV.
Matching: A-II, B-III, C-I, D-IV.
Answer: (D)
